entry.name: dict.codebox
entry.description: The dict.codebox object is a UI object for display and editing of dictionaries. Use the dict.codebox object to create named dictionaries, clone existing dictionaries, and query existing dictionaries to access their data.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Open a dictionary editor window by double-clicking
messages.description: Double-click aobject to open a dictionary editor window.

messages.name: append
messages.digest: Add values to an array.
messages.description: Add values to the end of an array associated with the specified key.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Send a reference to the dictionary from the first outlet.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Erase the contents of the dictionary, restoring to a clean state.

messages.name: clone
messages.digest: Make a clone of the incoming dictionary.
messages.description: Make a clone of the incoming dictionary. If received at the first inlet, send a reference to this new clone from the first outlet. Otherwise just clone the dictionary and don't send it out.

messages.name: contains
messages.digest: Return a 0 or 1 to the third outlet indicating the specified key exists (or doesn't) in the dictionary.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Make a clone of the incoming named-dictionary.
messages.description: Make a clone of the incoming dictionary. If received at the first inlet, send a reference to this new clone from the first outlet. Otherwise just clone the dictionary and don't send it out.

messages.name: edit
messages.digest: Open a dictionary editor window.

messages.name: export
messages.digest: Write the dictionary contents to a file
messages.description: Write the dictionary contents to a JSON or YAML file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. The file format is determined from the file name extension, either '.json' or '.yaml'. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: get
messages.digest: Return the value associated with a key to the second outlet.

messages.name: getkeys
messages.digest: Return a list of all the keys in a dictionary to the third outlet.
messages.description: Return a list of all the keys in a dictionary to the third outlet. By default the keys are sorted according to the order in which keys were added to the dictionary. Use the optional argument to specify alphabetical sorting.

messages.name: getnames
messages.digest: Return a list of all the dictionaries that currently exist to the fourth outlet.

messages.name: getsize
messages.digest: Return the number of values associated with a key to the second outlet.

messages.name: gettype
messages.digest: Return the type of the values associated with a key to the second outlet.

messages.name: import
messages.digest: Read the dictionary contents from a file
messages.description: Read the dictionary contents from a JSON or YAML file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. The file format is determined from the file name extension, either '.json' or '.yaml'. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: parse
messages.digest: Replace the content of a dictionary.
messages.description: Replace the content of a dictionary by providing the new content as JSON.

messages.name: pull_from_coll
messages.digest: Pull the content of a named coll object into the dictionary
messages.description: Pull the content of a named coll object into the dictionary. The indices in the coll will become the keys, and the values for those indices the values for the dictionary's keys.

messages.name: push_to_coll
messages.digest: Push the dictionary's content into a named coll object
messages.description: Push the dictionary's content into a named coll object. The keys in the dictionary will become the indices in the coll, and the values for those indices the values of the dictionary's keys.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read the dictionary contents from a file
messages.description: Read the dictionary contents from a JSON or YAML file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. The file format is determined from the file name extension, either '.json' or '.yaml'. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: readagain
messages.digest: Reload last used file from disk
messages.description: re-reads an JSON or YAML file previously specified by theormessages. If no file has been previously specified, a standard File Dialog will be presented for the user to manually choose the file to be read. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: readany
messages.digest: Read the dictionary contents from a file
messages.description: Read the dictionary contents from a JSON or YAML file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. The file format and extension are not checked. The contents of the file are assumed to be in JSON format. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: remove
messages.digest: Remove a key and its associated value from the dictionary.

messages.name: replace
messages.digest: Set the value for a key to a specified value, creating heirarchy.
messages.description: Set the value for a key to a specified value. If a heirarchy is specified for the key, and the heirarchy does not exist, then it will be created in the dictionary.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the value for a key to a specified value.

messages.name: setparse
messages.digest: Set the value for a key to a dictionary.
messages.description: Set the value for a key to dictionary content defined using JSON.

messages.name: wclose
messages.digest: Close the dictionary editor window.
messages.description: Close the dictionary editor window if it is open.

messages.name: write
messages.digest: Write the dictionary contents to a file
messages.description: Write the dictionary contents to a JSON or YAML file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. The file format is determined from the file name extension, either '.json' or '.yaml'. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.

messages.name: writeagain
messages.digest: Write the dictionary contents to a file
messages.description: Write the dictionary contents to a JSON or YAML file. The file provided as an argument for the previous 'write' or 'export' message will be used. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form.
